'''Mohammad Sal Moslehian''' (محمد صال مصلحیان)<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://profsite.um.ac.ir/~moslehian/|title=Prof. M. S. Moslehian's Homepage|website=profsite.um.ac.ir}}</ref> (born on 21 March 1966 in [[Mashhad]], [[Iran]]) is an Iranian mathematician and a professor of mathematics at [[Ferdowsi University of Mashhad]], Iran. He is the President of the [[Iranian Mathematical Society]] for the period of 2021-2024 and an invited member of the [[Iranian Academy of Sciences]]. His [[Erdős number]] is 3.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/freeTools.html?version=2|title=MR: Search MSC database|website=mathscinet.ams.org}}</ref> He is known for his contribution to the operator and norm [[inequality (mathematics)|inequality]]. He has developed the orthogonality in Hilbert C*-modules <ref>{{Cite journal|title=Orthogonality and parallelism of operators on various Banach spaces.|journal=J. Aust. Math. Soc.|year=2019|doi=10.1017/S1446788718000150|last1=Bottazzi|first1=T.|last2=Conde|first2=C.|last3=Moslehian|first3=M. S.|last4=Wójcik|first4=P.|last5=Zamani|first5=A.|volume=106|issue=2|pages=160–183|s2cid=119660817|url=https://rid.unrn.edu.ar/jspui/handle/20.500.12049/5358|arxiv=1609.06615}}</ref> and has significant contributions to operator means.<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Variants of Ando-Hiai inequality for operator power means|journal=Linear Multilinear Algebra|year=2021|doi=10.1080/03081087.2019.1635981|last1=Kian|first1=Mohsen|last2=Moslehian|first2=M. S.|last3=Seo|first3=Yuki|volume=69|issue=9|pages=1694–1704|s2cid=198443922}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|title=The arithmetic-geometric mean inequality of indefinite type|journal=Arch. Math. (Basel)|year=2021|doi=10.1007/s00013-021-01615-y|last1=Moslehian|first1=Mohammad Sal|last2=Sano|first2=Takashi|last3=Sugawara|first3=Kota|volume=117|issue=3|pages=347–359|s2cid=236552123}}</ref> He established noncommutative versions of martingale and maximum inequalities that play an essential role in noncommutative probability spaces.<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Etemadi and Kolmogorov inequalities in noncommutative probability spaces|journal=Michigan Math. J.|year=2019|doi=10.1307/mmj/1541667627|last1=Talebi|first1=Ali|last2=Moslehian|first2=Mohammad Sal|last3=Sadeghi|first3=Ghadir|volume=68|issue=1|pages=57–69|arxiv=1709.08044 |s2cid=119165187}}</ref> In addition, he has written several expository papers <ref>{{URL|http://profsite.um.ac.ir/~moslehian/}}</ref> discussing research<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Impact factor, an inadequate yardstick|journal=EMS Magazine|year=2021 |doi=10.4171/mag/19 |url=https://ems.press/journals/mag/articles/3718561 |last1=Moslehian |first1=Mohammad Sal |issue=120 |pages=40–42 |doi-access=free }}</ref> and education,<ref>{{Cite journal|title=School education, this is the problem|journal=Math and Soc.|url=https://math-sci.ui.ac.ir/article_25962_5236dbf5d3e60376cabd68d5f80bfd7f.pdf}}</ref> as well as promoting mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mct.iranjournals.ir/?_action=article&keywords=%D9%85%D8%B5%D9%84%D8%AD%DB%8C%D8%A7%D9%86|title=فرهنگ و اندیشه ریاضی - فهرست مقالات|website=mct.iranjournals.ir}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Moslehian obtained his Ph.D. from the [[Ferdowsi University of Mashhad]] under the supervision of Professor [[Assadollah Niknam]] in 1999. His research areas include [[Functional analysis|Functional Analysis]] and [[Operator theory|Operator Theory]], specifically [[operator algebra]]s<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Douglas factorization theorem revisited|journal=Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. |year=2019 |doi=10.1090/proc/14757 |last1=Manuilov |first1=Vladimir |last2=Moslehian |first2=M. S. |last3=Xu |first3=Qingxiang |volume=148 |issue=3 |pages=1139–1151 |s2cid=199116820|doi-access=free |arxiv=1807.00579 }}</ref> and [[Hilbert C*-module|Hilbert C<sup>*</sup>-modules]].<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert C*-modules|journal=Complex Anal. Oper. Theory |year=2022 |doi=10.1007/s11785-021-01179-3|last1=Moslehian |first1=Mohammad Sal |volume=16 |arxiv=2105.06515 |s2cid=234681733}}</ref> He spent his sabbatical leave at the [[University of Leeds]] (UK) and [[Karlstad University]] (Sweden) in 2006 and 2015 respectively and was a Senior Associate Researcher at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics|International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP, Trieste)]] for the period of 2012-2017 and a non-resident researcher of the [[Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences]] during 2006–2007. He supervised more than 20 PhD students.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=75481 |title=Mohammad Sal Moslehian - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref>

His most significant scientific-executive responsibilities are as follows:

* The President of the Iranian Mathematical Society (2021-2024).<ref name="auto">{{URL|https://fa.ims.ir/درباره-انجمن/تاریخچه/}}</ref>
* A member of the executive committee of the Iranian Mathematical Society (2004-2012) & (2021-2024).<ref name="auto"/> 
* An invited member of the Academy of Sciences (2015-).<ref>{{URL|http://www.ias.ac.ir/index.php/members/invited-scholars}}</ref>
* Vice Dean of the Faculty of Mathematical Science at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (2003-2004).<ref name="auto1">{{URL|http://mathstat.um.ac.ir}}</ref>
* Director of Center of Excellence in Analysis on Algebraic Structures (2007-).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran - Center of Excellence in Analysis on Algebraic Structures (CEAAS_ |url=https://en.um.ac.ir/content/Center-of-Excellence-in-Analysis-on-Algebraic-Structures-CEAAS |access-date=2022-06-17 |website=en.um.ac.ir}}</ref>
* General Director of Graduate Studies at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (2008-2012).<ref>{{URL|http://www.um.ac.ir}}</ref>
* Vice-Dean (Research Affairs) of the Faculty of Mathematical Science at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (2016-2018).<ref name="auto1"/>
* General Director of Research at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (2018-).<ref>{{Cite web |title=مدیر پژوهشی |url=https://vpr.um.ac.ir/index.php/fa/introduce/research-director |access-date=2022-06-17 |website=vpr.um.ac.ir}}</ref>
* The founder and director of the "Tusi Mathematical Research Group", Iran.<ref>{{URL|https://profsite.um.ac.ir/~moslehian/tmrg.htm}}</ref>

==Editorial board==
He is the founder and the editor-in-chief of three mathematics journals: [[Banach Journal of Mathematical Analysis]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/43037|title=Banach Journal of Mathematical Analysis|website=Springer}}</ref> [[Annals of Functional Analysis]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/43034|title=Annals of Functional Analysis}}</ref> and [[Advances in Operator Theory]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/43036|title=Advances in Operator Theory|website=Springer}}</ref> that are published by [[Springer Nature]]/[[Birkhäuser]] as well as being the editor-in-chief of the Bulletin of the Iranian Mathematical Society (2010-2011)<ref>{{URL|https://fa.ims.ir/بولتن/مسئولین/}}</ref> and the Newsletter of the Iranian Mathematical Society (2004-2007).<ref>{{URL|https://fa.ims.ir/خبرنامه/مسئولین/}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
Some of Moslehian's most important awards/honors for his contributions to mathematics include:

* A gold medal (third place) at the Annual Iranian Student Competition in Mathematics ('''مسابفه ریاضی دانشجویی کشوری''') organized by the [[Iranian Mathematical Society]] (1989).<ref>{{URL|https://fa.ims.ir}}</ref>
* A gold medal and award from Ferdowsi Academic Foundation ('''بنیاد دانشگاهی فردوسی''') as the distinguished academic member in Basic Sciences (2011).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://faf.um.ac.ir/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=405:2019-08-04-06-39-10&catid=105:uncategory&lang=fa|title=جایزه عضو هیئت علمی برجسته دانشگاه توسط بنیاد دانشگاهی فردوسی}}</ref>
* The Razavi Scientific award ('''نشان علمی رضوی''') as an elected researcher in Basic Sciences by the governor-general of [[Razavi Khorasan Province]] (2016).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.um.ac.ir/news/استاد-دانشکده-علوم-ریاضی-نشان-ویژه-استاد-برگزیده-جشنواره-علمی-رضوی-را-دریافت-کرد.html|title=استاد دانشکده علوم ریاضی نشان ویژه استاد برگزیده جشنواره علمی رضوی را دریافت کرد|first=مدیر|last=سیستم|date=12 February 2018|website=دانشگاه فردوسی مشهد}}</ref>
* An award as a distinguished researcher elected by [[Ministry of Science, Research and Technology (Iran)|Ministry of Science, Research and Technology]] and a certificate from the first vice president of Iran (2018).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iribnews.ir/fa/news/2305044|title=استاد دانشگاه فردوسی پژوهشگر برتر کشور شد|first=IRIB NEWS AGENCY {{pipe}} خبرگزاری صدا و|last=سیما|date=26 September 1397|website=fa}}</ref>
* Recipient of the national [[Allame Tabatabaei Award]] ('''جايزه علامه طباطبايى''') and certificate from a vice president of Iran (2019).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://fa.ims.ir/2019/11/20/%d8%af%da%a9%d8%aa%d8%b1-%d9%85%d8%ad%d9%85%d8%af-%d8%b5%d8%a7%d9%84-%d9%85%d8%b5%d9%84%d8%ad%db%8c%d8%a7%d9%86-%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%af%d8%a7%d9%86%d8%b4%da%af%d8%a7%d9%87-%d9%81%d8%b1/|title=آقای دکتر محمد صال مصلحیان استاد دانشگاه فردوسی مشهد به عنوان برگزیده پنجمین دوره جایزه علمی علامه طباطبایی انتخاب شد – انجمن ریاضی ایران}}</ref>
